extracted.intended_audience: software engineers and code reviewers (including ML/data-science teams)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidelines for performing constructive, effective code reviews within engineering teams (applicable to general software and ML/data-science teams). Emphasizes what to check, how to communicate, approval discipline, escalation, and onboarding-sensitive review practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity of title, description, and the *why* of the change
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarity of title, description, and the *why* of the change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code correctness, test coverage, adherence to standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Code correctness, test coverage, adherence to standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag unclear naming, commented-out code, untested sections, edge cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag unclear naming, commented-out code, untested sections, edge cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review changes in context of the larger system / architecture
rubrics_metrics.description: Review changes in context of the larger system / architecture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone and communication
rubrics_metrics.description: "Ask open-ended questions instead of making strong or opinionated statements." Offer alternatives without insisting they're the only solution. Assume you might be missing context; ask for clarification. Be empathetic; recognize the author's effort. Celebrate good solutions with positive feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval / change-request discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't approve while open-ended questions remain unanswered. Distinguish blocking vs. non-blocking comments. Be explicit when approving ("LGTM"). Be flexible on practice but firm on principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Escalation
rubrics_metrics.description: Switch to face-to-face discussion when back-and-forth gets long. Account for time zones.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nitpicks
rubrics_metrics.description: Mark nitpicks with "nit:" prefix. Frequent nitpicks signal missing tooling — automate linting.

rubrics_metrics.name: New employees / onboarding-sensitive reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide extra explanation of alternatives. Point to relevant guides. Especially positive tone for early contributions.
